reason: Three months free and they do the setup, so I lose nothing by trying. I already take orders on WhatsApp, and the udhaar going from my paper diary into one place is what pulls me.
objection: Will it really catch my phone-call orders correctly without me doing anything? If it gets one wrong and I miss a customer's order or write the wrong udhaar, I will go straight back to my diary.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it handle a few of my own real phone-call and voice-note orders correctly in front of me before I commit.
